rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a concrete land-transfer template: it identifies specifically described lands, includes improvements located on them, and transfers/restores jurisdiction to another governmental authority. The child uses the same operative machinery on a much larger scale, transferring jurisdiction over described lands and associated improvements from Agriculture to Interior. C08 and C14 also concern transfers of control or jurisdiction over described tracts, but their supplied text contains less of the operative transfer language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: jurisdiction over all lands in the following-described areas ... together with waters or water rights, improvements, and structures ... is hereby transferred to the Department of the Interior
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following-described lands ... together with all improvements located thereon, are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Both provisions use the distinctive sequence of identifying following-described lands, including attached improvements, and transferring governmental jurisdiction over them.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Subject to valid existing rights, jurisdiction over all lands in the following-described areas
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following-described lands, comprising a part of the United States Naval Reservation at Hanapepe
shared_material.explanation: Both introduce the operative jurisdictional disposition through a formal description of specified land, followed by detailed survey material.
